page.layout: One column of names, set in short groups separated by blank lines. Running head at the top left, cut at the edge. Above the list, two italic labels set right of centre, with a gathering mark at top right. No text below the list.; One column of list lines, with the left edge cut off. Running head at the top, with the page number at top right. Below it, a list of years and names, with the "Agrarij." and "GUBERNATOR" headings set apart. Catchword at bottom right.
page.notes: The gathering mark "G v" stands at the top right beside "Erueflus", so it is not transcribed here as a signature. A small printed diamond ornament stands between the groups of names after "Peter Isebrants." and is not transcribed. The long s is written as a plain s throughout. The last letter of "Schonenbor" is cut at the edge and is marked [?]. The left edge is cut away, so the start of the running head, the start of "GUBERNATOR." and a small fragment "ch." beside the 1626 line are not fully readable. The "ch." fragment was left out as edge remnant. "Naffovia" is copied as printed (ff ligature). "Rempt Iensema" and "Iensema" were read as Jensema (consonant I to J). The catchword "Peter" is underlined and its last letter is uncertain.
